name: vref-transfer
description: VREF-to-VOUT small-signal transfer over frequency at the light-load (1 mA) condition -- the reference-referred follow-up campaign named by DR-0021
claim: spec/decision-records/DR-0021-vref-is-a-top-level-port.md, Decision #3 contract table, 'Accuracy / tempco / noise / its own PSRR' row: a real VREF driver's tempco, noise and PSRR 'flow straight through to VOUT at 1/beta = 1.5x' and are 'not in any ratified row of this block's spec'. This bench measures that transfer directly, |Vout(f)/Vref(f)| in dB, at the ratified light-load (1 mA, binding per README.md note 1) condition, across the full PVT matrix -- new evidence, not a correction of any existing sim/ record (DR-0021 Consequences #4-#5). It could not be written before #174/DR-0021 promoted VREF to a top-level port, since there was no port to drive an AC stimulus from. This deck covers the 1 mA condition ONLY; the 50 mA condition is its own sibling experiment, sim/vref-transfer-50ma/, following the same split sim/psrr-vs-freq/ / sim/psrr-vs-freq-50ma/ (#99) already use for the ratified PSRR row's two load conditions, and for the identical reason (ngspice's per-.meas result vectors go out of scope once a second .ac becomes the current plot -- see sim/psrr-vs-freq/testbench/tb_psrr.spice's header). There is no ratified numeric threshold for this transfer itself (it is new evidence establishing one, not verifying against an existing spec line), so `checks` below is limited to the harness-integrity gates (dc_vout_v, dc_iload_ma) that confirm the .ac was linearized about the physical operating point with the sink delivering the commanded current -- the same convention sim/psrr-vs-freq/ uses. The derived tempco/noise/PSRR budget a real VREF driver must meet is written up in this bench's README.md, not asserted as a pass/fail gate here.
analyses: meas ac vref_10hz FIND vdb(vout) AT=10
meas ac vref_1k FIND vdb(vout) AT=1k
meas ac vref_100k FIND vdb(vout) AT=100k
meas ac vref_1meg FIND vdb(vout) AT=1meg

operating_conditions.load_current: 1 mA (binding light-load condition per README.md note 1), commanded through a compliance-limited sink (Vilc/Bload/Vlmeas) and verified by dc_iload_ma
operating_conditions.output_cap: 1.0 uF nominal + 100 mOhm ESR (same output network as the ratified PSRR row's decks)
operating_conditions.enable_state: enabled (EN tied to VIN at instantiation)

dc_iload_ma.description: Harness integrity, not a ratified spec line: the compliance-limited sink must deliver the commanded 1 mA at the operating point this .ac is expanded about

dc_vout_v.description: Harness integrity, not a ratified spec line: asserts the .ac was linearized about the physical operating point, not the sub-ground root #40 found
